title: Editor E3: Site is a fourth kind (legality, column ceiling, palette exclusions, starters)
detail: Site is the one surface still outside the registry's three kinds (member, space, email). It needs the four things email got: a legal block set (kinds), a column ceiling (MAX_COLUMNS_BY_KIND), a palette allowlist, and a renderer (the web one, behind a surface filter). The published flag already exists (lib/spaces/website.ts). Carved out of PROG-E3 when its density half closed. Start with the legality and ceiling in the type, then the filter. Done 2026-10-20: EntityKind names site; its block legality is the Space's (blockSupportsKind), its column ceiling is 2 on its own entry, its palette exclusions and starters mirror the Space's, and site-kind.test.ts pins all four. The renderer and surface filter are LIVE-1172.
